department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, Government of India
benefit: Poor households get a free LPG gas connection. The government pays Rs 1,600 for a 14.2 kg cylinder connection (Rs 1,150 for a 5 kg cylinder). This covers the cylinder deposit, regulator, hose, gas card and fitting charges. You also get the first refill and a stove free.

other: The connection is given to an adult woman of the household.

Your household must be in one of these groups: SC, ST, PMAY (Gramin), Most Backward Classes, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), tea garden tribes, forest dwellers, people on islands, SECC households, or a poor household by a 14-point declaration.
No one else in your household should have an LPG connection.

documents: Ration card (or other state document showing family members; migrants can give a self-declaration)
Aadhaar of the woman and the adults in the family
how_to_apply: Apply online on the PMUY site, or fill the KYC form and give it with your papers to your nearest LPG distributor.
where_to_apply: Nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharat Gas or HP Gas), or online at pmuy.gov.in
